About All Spelling

A mixed spelling review across the vocabulary topics: number words, days, months, weather, fruit, parts of the body and clothes. The learner hears a word and types it. Multiple choice is there for an easier round.

How to play

  1. Listen to the word.
  2. Type it.
  3. Check your spelling.

Play it as a class

Choose All Spelling in the Teacher Game for an end-of-week spelling quiz.
